notes: Cross-cutting registry per standard section 15. New public or protected routes must map to applicable entries and inherit their mandatory interaction tuples.

interactions.mechanism: Global Axios request/response interceptors: bearer injection, atomic single-flight token refresh with failed-request queue, 401 redirect to /login (or /retail/login), and skipAuthInterceptors opt-out for public credential-bearing calls.
mandatory_tuples: public endpoint x anonymous session x expected 4xx x global auth interceptor
public endpoint x stale contextual session x explicit no-auth request
protected endpoint x expired access token x valid refresh token
protected endpoint x expired access token x missing/invalid refresh token
user-visible failure x route stability x fixed neutral copy x zero secret leakage

interactions.mechanism: Schema-per-tenant routing: TenantContext resolution from JWT, tenant-scoped session with SET LOCAL search_path, per-request finalize (commit/rollback), and tenant filtering guards.
mandatory_tuples: multi-tenant identity x each workspace x authorization and isolation
tenant-local operation x shared pool/search path x another tenant
suspended/deactivated tenant x contextual session x supported recovery path

interactions.mechanism: Redis-backed token-bucket rate limiter keyed by client IP/endpoint, enforced by ASGI middleware with rate-limit response headers and 429 rejection.
mandatory_tuples: rate-limited route x anonymous context x 429 x no side effects
rate-limited route x authenticated context x 429 x rate-limit headers
rate-limited route x rejected-auth context x no session creation

interactions.mechanism: Canonical-key payment declaration replay resolution (same key/same payload returns original, same key/different payload rejected) plus the general X-Idempotency-Key middleware replay cache.
mandatory_tuples: idempotent mutation x duplicate click x single persistence effect
idempotent mutation x replayed request x original result returned
idempotent mutation x concurrent request x exactly one record
same idempotency key x different payload x explicit rejection

interactions.mechanism: Hash-locked single-use token rows (reset and invitation): expiry/used/revoked/soft-deleted states, used-at marked only after the guarded mutation succeeds, issuance filtered to unused tokens.
mandatory_tuples: token link x valid token x single-use consumption
token link x expired token x neutral rejection
token link x used token x replay denied
token link x revoked token x neutral rejection
token link x forged token x neutral rejection x no enumeration

interactions.mechanism: Per-request tenant transaction ownership: finalize_tenant_context commits on success and rolls back on failure; services never commit or roll back themselves.
mandatory_tuples: tenant request success x commit x complete state
tenant request failure mid-transaction x rollback x no partial state
service-layer exception x no self-managed commit x caller-owned boundary

interactions.mechanism: Dual-mode sidebar: fixed desktop rail and conditionally-mounted mobile off-canvas drawer below the lg breakpoint, with drawer close on route change/Escape/backdrop and content shift.
mandatory_tuples: mobile route x long content x navigation drawer x no layout overflow
mobile route x form submission x drawer closed x single submission
viewport 390px x back/forward x route stability x no stuck backdrop
